summary: Iter 232N.59 Admin Test Sandbox — verified end-to-end. All 11 unit pytests pass; N54..N59 regression is 43/43 green. Wrote a new live-HTTP suite (10/10 pass) covering presets, create sandbox, list, add-user, list-users filter, impersonate-start guard (403 for non-test-account, 200 for test-account), and cascade delete. UI verified with Playwright: admin sidebar tab opens the sandbox panel, all 3 preset buttons, shared password chip + copy, create/max buttons, existing-league row testids (add-user/open/delete/impersonate-select) all present. Impersonate select launched impersonation, redirected to /dashboard, and the ImpersonationBanner rendered with correct text ('You are viewing as testuserN_XXXXXX@sandbox.local — read-only · expires in MM:SS · impersonator: admin@dynastydreams.com'). Delete cascade removed everything cleanly. No sandboxes left behind after test.

issues: A 'Platform admin access required' toast fires when the impersonated user's dashboard tries to load admin-only data (e.g. active-league admin endpoint returning 403). Not a functional bug — impersonation correctly downgrades role — but the errant toast could confuse admins. Consider suppressing platform-admin failures on the dashboard while impersonating, or gating that call on !isImpersonating.

action_items: Optional polish: while impersonating, suppress the 'Platform admin access required' toast triggered by the dashboard's active-league admin fetch.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_test_sandbox router is well isolated with a _deps injection pattern that makes unit testing clean.
Impersonation guard correctly checks is_test_account before minting the impersonation token — 403 returned with 'test-sandbox' in the detail message as specified.
Delete cascade correctly preserves users that own a team in another sandbox (verified in unit + live tests).
Frontend TestSandboxPanel exposes every required data-testid (verified in Playwright).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all data-testids present, impersonation E2E works, banner renders)

test_credentials: admin@dynastydreams.com / Admin123! (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Sandbox users use shared password TestUser2026! but were reached via impersonation instead.
seed_data_creation: One transient sandbox league was created via the UI during Playwright testing and afterwards deleted via the DELETE endpoint. No test data left in DB.
